description: This Java class defines a fragment called LogFragment, which manages a LogView component within a ScrollView. It is used to display log messages and provides methods to initialize and interact with the log display in an Android app.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that creates a scrollable log view, allowing logs to be displayed and automatically scrolled to the bottom when updated.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and returns the view hierarchy containing the LogView within a ScrollView.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates the views, sets up a text change listener to auto-scroll, and returns the main view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Provides access to the LogView instance managed by this fragment.
